what: Advanced Drainage Systems makes corrugated plastic pipe and the chambers, basins and fittings that manage stormwater on construction sites, mostly from recycled plastic.
customers: Site contractors, civil engineers and builders managing drainage on construction projects.
money: septic chambers, tanks and water management systems
moat: The largest plastic pipe recycler in North America, with plants near customers because pipe is bulky and expensive to ship, and products written into engineers' drainage specifications.
risks: Non-residential and residential construction both fell with interest rates
Revenue has been flat around $3.1B for three years
Resin prices move the cost base
opportunities: A 14.0% net margin and $530M of free cash flow, exceptional for a pipe maker
Analysts see about 47% upside, with 12 covering the stock
Plastic pipe keeps taking share from concrete because it is lighter, cheaper to install and lasts longer
watch: Pipe volumes and whether construction activity recovers.
